note: No design you open flies differently. The user guide has a glossary: 253 entries, each saying what a word means, where you meet it in the app and, where it matters, what to watch for; it roughly doubles the guide, which the app still reads only when you open it. Recovery sizing now quotes a parachute that states no Cd of its own at the simulator's automatic 0.8 it flies, reduced for its spill hole, where it borrowed your other chute's Cd or used an unvented 0.8: of the 974 design files that open among the 1,070 the app is checked against, 25 size lines change (23 larger, as much as 66 %; two 3 % smaller) and 278 grow by a median 2 %. A chute with no canopy diameter ranks and scales as the 0.3 m it flies. The OOP badge no longer marks the 27 motors thrustcurve.org lists as produced occasionally. The guide has over 40 corrections, and now states that a transition's shoulders add no mass and that a lug or rail button high above the aft end makes the rod-exit speed read high. v0.141's note was wrong about its dependency update: it changed build and test tools and one unused nested copy of fflate, not the libraries the page runs.
